messages:
Emily (CSM): quick heads-up — we need to send a status update to a subset of accounts affected by the weekend latency spike. Draft below, please review and tell me if anything is off.

Emily (CSM): DRAFT to customers: 
Hi — we experienced elevated generation latency between Sat 02:14–03:05 UTC affecting text-generation requests for some workloads. Our team has implemented mitigation (routing to a lower-latency model variant and temporary request throttling) which restored normal response times by 03:05 UTC. We continue to monitor and are investigating root cause. If you saw increased timeouts or slow responses, reply here and we will prioritize your account for a follow-up. We will share a full technical update and next steps by Mon EOD. — Emily from Redwood CS

Mike (AE): +1 on the note. Can we add a short line about impact on SLAs and credits? Some enterprise contacts will ask.

Emily (CSM): good call. adding: "We will evaluate SLA impacts and reach out individually about credits where applicable."

Sara (CS): suggest an optional line for customers who use Dedicated: "If you are on Dedicated pools and continue to see issues, file a support ticket with tag #dedicated and we'll escalate."

Emily (CSM): added. Updated draft below. Sending in 10 if no objections.

Ops Bot: Incident alert posted: "GEN-LATENCY-2026-03-20" — severity: P2. Affected regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1. Mitigation applied: traffic reroute to variant v2-q4.

Infra Oncall: quick tech note to include in follow-up RCA: we observed an unexpected cache-eviction storm tied to a change in prefix-key hashing after a rollout; that amplified KV cache miss rates leading to higher per-token compute. Rollback of the hashing change has been performed in us-east-1; full fix being validated.

Mike (AE): thanks for the note — customers will want ETA for the RCA and whether this could recur. can we promise an actionable timeline?

Infra Oncall: aiming for preliminary RCA by Mon 14:00 UTC, detailed postmortem with mitigation plan by Tue 18:00 UTC. Will include repro steps, diff of the rollout, and suggested config guards.

Emily (CSM): final draft to send now: 
Hi — we experienced elevated generation latency between Sat 02:14–03:05 UTC affecting text-generation requests for some customers in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. We applied mitigation (traffic reroute to a lower-latency model variant and temporary rate controls) and normal response times were restored by 03:05 UTC. We will individually evaluate SLA impact and reach out about credits where applicable.

If you are on Dedicated pools and continue to see issues, please open a support ticket with tag #dedicated and we will escalate immediately.

A preliminary technical summary will be shared by Mon 14:00 UTC and a full post-incident report with corrective actions by Tue 18:00 UTC. We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience. — Emily, Redwood CS

Sara (CS): LGTM.

Mike (AE): ok to send. please cc me on enterprise replies so i can handle renewal-sensitive accounts.

Emily (CSM): will send now and tag affected account threads. assigning follow-ups:
- Emily: send customer broadcast + follow individual replies
- Infra Oncall: produce preliminary RCA by Mon 14:00 UTC
- Sara: triage any Dedicated tickets flagged #dedicated
- Mike: support enterprise escalations / renewal concerns

Emily (CSM): note for thread: capture feedback in the customer-feedback tracker (sheet link) and add any asks for model-performance tuning to the onboarding backlog.

Ops Bot: Reminder set: follow-up check Mon 14:05 UTC.
